description: toolbox (locked at 9b190de9) now has buck2-toolchain 4 (buck2 2026-07-01) and 5 (buck2 2026-09-15). Update the input, move turnkey to 5, add both releases to nix/buck2/buck2-source.nix after the test-runner parity suite passes on each, and make sure every gate still passes. Write down what the upgrade took as a reusable checklist for future buck2/toolbox upgrades.

comments.text: Parked (2026-09-25) as local commit 'chore: update toolbox...' on top of turnkey-vnm/test-result-caching, not pushed. Done and verified on buck2-toolchain 5. Remaining: the upgrade checklist, and fixing the user manual's remote-endpoint note (on buck2 2026-09-15 an unreachable cache means ~45s of retries then a local run, not failures). Paused for the effort to bundle buck2 inside turnkey, which changes what an upgrade involves (consumers would no longer pick buck2 versions).

title: Update toolbox and support buck2-toolchain 4 and 5
